mapper.select:
select distinct rp.id, rp.app_id, rp.res_id, rp.perm_name, rp.perm_code from perm_unit_user puu join perm_unit_resource pur on puu.unit_id = pur.unit_id join resource_perm rp on pur.perm_id = rp.id join org_tree ot on puu.org_id = ot.id
puu.user_id = #{userId} and puu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ot.id_path like concat(#{orgIdPath}, '%') and pur.app_id = #{appId} and puu.forbidden=0
mapper.insert:
insert ignore into perm_unit_user (id, unit_id, user_id, org_id, tenant_id, create_user, update_user) values
(#{u.id}, #{u.unitId}, #{u.userId}, #{u.orgId}, #{u.tenantId}, #{u.createUser}, #{u.updateUser})
mapper.select:
select puu.id as grant_id, puu.user_id, u.account, u.real_name as user_name, puu.org_id, ot.node_name as org_name, puu.create_time, puu.create_user from perm_unit_user puu join sys_user u on puu.user_id = u.id join org_tree ot on puu.org_id = ot.id where puu.unit_id = #{vo.unitId}
and u.real_name like concat('%', #{vo.keyword}, '%')

select distinct app.id as app_id, app.name_cn, app.memo, app.icon, tenant_app.forbidden, tenant_app.id as grant_id, tenant_app.create_user, tenant_app.create_time from app join perm_unit_resource pur on app.id = pur.app_id join perm_unit_user puu on puu.unit_id = pur.unit_id join tenant_app on (app.id = tenant_app.app_id and tenant_app.tenant_id = puu.tenant_id)
tenant_app.delete_time = 0
and tenant_app.forbidden = 0
and puu.user_id = #{userId} and puu.org_id = #{orgId} and puu.forbidden = 0
order by app.show_order

select distinct pur.perm_id from perm_unit_user puu join perm_unit_resource pur on puu.unit_id = pur.unit_id join org_tree ot on puu.org_id = ot.id
puu.forbidden = 0 and puu.user_id = #{userId} and ot.id_path like concat(#{orgIdPath}, '%') and ot.delete_time = 0

select distinct rp.res_id from perm_unit_user puu join perm_unit_resource pur on puu.unit_id = pur.unit_id join resource_perm rp on rp.id = pur.perm_id join org_tree ot on puu.org_id = ot.id
puu.user_id = #{userId} and ot.id_path like concat(#{orgIdPath}, '%') and puu.forbidden = 0

tenant_id = #{tenantId} and unit_id in
#{item}
